1.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_000
1.description: Well met! I am Scanningway, data analyst for the Cosmic Exploration Initiative.

2.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_010
2.description: My duty is to record the efforts of each member and tally them up at regular intervals.

3.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_020
3.description: Not only does this data improve the efficiency of the initiative as a whole, but it highlights the individuals whose achievements are worthy of a reward.

4.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_030
4.description: Members with the highest metrics within a given period are given the vaunted title of “Star Contributor.”

5.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_035
5.description: As a token of our appreciation, anyone recognized as such shall have their name displayed prominently for all to see!

6.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_100_040
6.description: If you should have any questions, I recommend that you consult your exotablet.

7.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_200_000
7.description: Thank you for your contributions to the Cosmic Exploration Initiative, but I'm afraid your metrics are not being recorded at this time.

8.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_000
8.description: Thank you for your contributions to the Cosmic Exploration Initiative! Rest assured I have been recording everyone's metrics for the current data collection period.

13.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_010
13.description: My apologies. I am not currently recording any metrics, so I'm afraid I have nothing to offer you.

14.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_020
14.description: Let me just pull up your latest metrics for the current data collection period... Ah, here we are!

15.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_030
15.description: At present, you have reached...the top ten percent!? That's astounding! You just might be one of our Star Contributors this period!

16.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_040
16.description: At present, you have reached...the top twenty percent! Keep it up, and the title of “Star Contributor” could be yours this period!

17.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_050
17.description: At present, you have reached...the top thirty percent. An impressive achievement!

18.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_060
18.description: At present, you have reached...the top fifty percent. You can do better than average, surely! Keep at it!

19.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_070
19.description: At present, you have reached... Well, your name has been recorded, if nothing else. Take your time!

20.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_080
20.description: It appears I have no record of your achievements this period. Now's the time to get started!

21.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_090
21.description: Well, well, if it isn't Star Contributor <hex:022903EB0203> in the flesh! On behalf of the initiative, thank you for all your hard work!

22.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_100
22.description: Well, well, if it isn't Star Contributor <hex:022903EB0203> in the flesh!

23.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_110
23.description: As of this data collection period, you are once again eligible to earn the title. Let that serve as motivation for even greater contributions, hmmm?

24.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SCANNINGWAY_300_120
24.description: Now, where were we...? Ah, yes, your latest metrics!

25.name: TEXT_CTSWKSDELEGATIONMEMBER_00927_SYSTEM_300_010
25.description: Upon selection, Star Contributors cannot be reselected for fourteen days.
